Splice raw parameter text before arithmetic parse. Never recursively run shell expansion on resulting bytes.
Missing/empty handling uses existing requireParameter; overflow-safe index lookup cannot allocate by numeric index.
Before allocating/appending, account current-source +inserted byte lengths against existing maxExpansionBytes; use existing shell-owned/array bridge accounting where applicable, no new Budget/reset.
Preserve arithmeticVariables proxy, readonly/stale/error/caller precedence and existing synchronous evaluator work/depth/int64 rules.
